Repair Glued Tokens in a Name Vector

Source: R/parse_one_name.R
deglue_tokens.Rd

Always applies split_glued_honorific() (Defect 2), and from the third token on split_glued_credentials() (JRMD, MDMPH). The stray-initial split split_glued_initial() (Defect 3) is applied only when split_initials is TRUE, because it cannot be made safe from a single record: a foreign given name absent from the census (e.g. KYUN) is indistinguishable from a glued initial + surname (C + WOOLFOLK) on frequency alone, so it should run only where cross-year consensus (synthid) can vet the result.

Usage

deglue_tokens(name_vec, split_initials = FALSE)

Arguments

name_vec

A character vector of name tokens.

split_initials

Logical; enable the Defect 3 stray-initial split. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A character vector, possibly longer than the input.
